text: The fascinating world of astronomy is all about exploring the universe and learning about the stars, planets, and galaxies that make up our cosmic home. Craters can be found on many celestial bodies, including Earth's Moon and Mars, where scientists study the history of the Solar System. Orbiting celestial bodies such as the Earth, Moon, and Mars also have their own moons, including Earth's Moon and Mars' Phobos and Deimos. The study of these celestial bodies helps us understand the evolution and formation of our Solar System and the broader context of the universe as a whole.
